evidence_snapshot.snapshot_note: heads re-frozen 2026-09-13 after Phase-1 push; deltas since Phase 1: BRAMASTRA 02b94d3->f25fc96 (engineering build B00-B12, no science), citadel 1d27f9b->e96c9a9 (CITADEL-DATA-001 executed audit), NEW branch eval-integrity-001 915e23f (CITADEL-EVAL-001), codex 1511321->516c280 (refactor only)

beliefs.statement: A dense causal decoder-only Transformer is the right Core family for the next generation.
beliefs.prior_justification: Simplest sufficient baseline; architecture soup destroys causal attribution (master doc law 13); no bottleneck evidence demands alternatives
beliefs.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH (as baseline choice, NOT as proven superiority)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A demonstrated formation/retention failure that a specific alternative mechanism resolves under matched compute
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: none known at current evidence level; keep baseline until an isolated bottleneck implicates architecture
beliefs.value_of_resolving: LOW now (would only matter after representation/formation gates close)

beliefs.statement: A delayed memorize-then-generalize transition exists and replicates at micro scale; stopping at train saturation misses it.
beliefs.prior_justification: Qualitative transition replicated across fresh seeds; reused as the exposure benchmark by all Cymek GPU campaigns
plausible_alternatives: task-specific artifact (bounded: multiple task families now)
beliefs.confidence: HIGH within micro T2-class tasks; scale transfer unknown
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A substrate where train saturation coincides with held-out lift-off reliably (would narrow scope, not invert)

beliefs.statement: Memorization timing does not predict generalization timing (rho ~ 0).
beliefs.prior_justification: Prospective 4-seed probe battery; reanalysis demoted precursor to marker
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A prospective predictor that beats chance across fresh seeds and task families

beliefs.statement: Declared tied embedding/output class-space size causally changes held-out capability formation, non-monotonically (intermediate 4096-16384 best at development scale).
beliefs.prior_justification: Only variable changed in R1 (100% vs 12.94% vs 0%); ordering replicated directionally across two fresh seeds in R1B
contradicting_experiments: ARK-001 (apparent; resolved as different manipulation - whole-vocab swap vs declared class space)
beliefs.confidence: MEDIUM-HIGH for effect existence; LOW for mechanism; amplitude seed-sensitive
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: R1C shows MASK arms behave like FULL at the fixed 24,576 matrix AND a mechanism alternative explains R1/R1B ordering

beliefs.statement: Training-time inactive-class softmax competition is THE mechanism behind the class-space effect.
beliefs.prior_justification: Most plausible current hypothesis; OFFSET arm in R1C tests partition-mass sufficiency
beliefs.confidence: SPECULATIVE by design until R1C executes
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: R1C primary causal pair fails (mean paired AUC gap < 0.10, no G50 advantage)

beliefs.statement: The frozen 24,576 BPE production representation cannot form held-out arithmetic capability even at full ARK-002B exposure, on the 4L/128w V5 geometry.
beliefs.prior_justification: One executed subject at 100% reference exposure with 0% held-out and 0/48 sealed
contradicting_experiments: CYR-GPU-012-R1 (V24576 arm replicates the 0% - consistent, not contradicting)
plausible_alternatives: seed-specific (not replicated with a second production-arm seed)
beliefs.confidence: MEDIUM (single seed; condition-level result strong, universal claim weak)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A production-representation arm forming capability at matched exposure in a replication
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: one V24576 arm rerun with a fresh seed inside CS-TRANSFER-001

beliefs.statement: The class-space/representation formation effect transfers to natural-language tokenization and larger models.
beliefs.prior_justification: No transfer experiment exists
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: CS-TRANSFER-001 shows < 0.10 formation gap at 8L/256w
beliefs.value_of_resolving: VERY HIGH (decides whether tokenizer is a 500M-blocking variable)

beliefs.statement: Low applied update magnitude protects an already-acquired invariant under matched continuation.
beliefs.prior_justification: HIGH 9/12 vs LOW 0/12 (RD -0.75); recurrence 3/6 vs 0/6; NARROW_LOW 0/8; ARK-017 LOW 0/6
contradicting_experiments: ARK-010 (LOW fails at recovery - boundary, not contradiction)
plausible_alternatives: effective LR near zero acts as temporary freeze (mechanism unresolved)
beliefs.confidence: HIGH at micro T2; scale transfer unknown
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A production-scale continuation where LOW fails while matched HIGH protects
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: retention fork embedded in any future campaign at larger scale

beliefs.statement: High plasticity is required for recovery when capability is absent; immediate LOW after collapse is harmful.
beliefs.prior_justification: HIGH recovered 8/9 vs LOW 2/9
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: Recovery regime where immediate LOW matches HIGH

beliefs.statement: Canonical accuracy can stay perfect while broader invariance collapses under narrowed high-plasticity continuation.
beliefs.prior_justification: 8/8 vs 0/8 vs 0/8 with canonical 1.0 and robust mean ~0.47
beliefs.confidence: HIGH (one task family, replicated across 3 parents)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: Task family where canonical retention implies robust retention
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: robustness probes on future continuation arms (cheap, embeddable)

beliefs.statement: Retention is governed by an interaction of applied update magnitude and continued capability-relevant support, not by parameter displacement.
beliefs.prior_justification: Both levers independently sufficient (0/6 each); replay arm moved farther than failing HIGH; displacement story falsified
plausible_alternatives: single mechanism with two proximal causes
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A regime where neither lever protects, or where protection tracks displacement
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: gradient-direction diagnostics inside the next retention fork (ARK-017-style instrumentation)

beliefs.statement: Total parameter displacement from the acquired state causes capability loss.
beliefs.prior_justification: Falsified twice by movement-outcome dissociation
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a (status is the falsification)

beliefs.statement: A unique numeric capability-state threshold for LR switching exists and is discoverable from behavioral screens.
beliefs.prior_justification: TIME_NOT_STATE_SCREEN; thresholds alias to switch times
plausible_alternatives: time-based policies (FIXED_TIME) as the practical control
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A screen with more sources that separates state from time

beliefs.statement: There is a universal replay dose (e.g. 1/64) for retention protection.
beliefs.prior_justification: 1/64 and 1/16 protected in screens; secondary single-order screens cannot establish universality (explicitly disclaimed)
contradicting_experiments: BRM-replay-retention (this-regime replay variant rejected; receipt provenance weak - see EVIDENCE_GAPS G17)
plausible_alternatives: dose depends on task geometry and interference structure
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A dose-response experiment showing protection saturates/fails at different doses across task families
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: two-dose contrast inside the next continuation campaign (already cheap)

beliefs.statement: LR policy alone can manage cross-task interference without replay/support.
beliefs.prior_justification: Every arm lost sustained T2 under 12k no-replay T3-only training
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a (bounded falsification)

beliefs.statement: New-skill formation is a prerequisite gate: controller comparisons are uninterpretable until the unprotected reference acquires the new skill.
beliefs.prior_justification: Two campaigns (ARK-013, ARK-019 V3.1) had their primary questions voided by formation failure; V4/ARK-020 encode formation-first gates
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A controller verdict that remains interpretable despite reference formation failure (none known)

beliefs.statement: A dynamic escalation Guardian can preserve an old skill while a new one is acquired, at lower replay cost than permanent rehearsal.
beliefs.prior_justification: V3.1: official CONTROLLER_NOT_SUPPORTED (formation bottleneck); V4: transcribed external audit claims GUARDIAN_CONTINUAL_PROXY_CANDIDATE (old 4/4 + new 4/4) with raw bundle absent from repo
plausible_alternatives: static sparse replay is equally good (V3.1: 0.882 vs 0.963; V4 claims Guardian matches static at lower cost - unverified)
beliefs.confidence: LOW-MEDIUM; cannot be settled in-repo today
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: Byte audit fails, or a rerun shows Guardian arms do not beat matched static replay on retention-at-replay-cost
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: recover + audit the V4 bundle (zero GPU if it exists); else rerun the V4 Guardian-vs-static contrast
beliefs.value_of_resolving: VERY HIGH (decides the whole continual-learning line)

beliefs.statement: The weak V4 checkpoint contains a latent query-conditioned selection signal usable for addressing research.
beliefs.prior_justification: Raw rank exactly at chance (0.2500), QCS CI includes 0 both seeds, position dominates query 19-35x; replicated; BRAMASTRA independently showed aggregate binding accuracy is query-blind-explainable
plausible_alternatives: signal exists but is below measurement floor on this substrate (floor-limited, not proof of absence)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A qualified (readiness-v2-passing) checkpoint showing above-chance QCS
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: re-run the QV matrix on any future qualified checkpoint

beliefs.statement: Value-recency repair effects demonstrate entity addressing.
beliefs.prior_justification: Value insertion repairs ~46% while entity alone repairs ~0%; effect is answer-bearing salience, not addressing
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a

beliefs.statement: Answer+EOS supervision is required for complete answers; termination and content failures are separable and must be measured separately.
beliefs.prior_justification: 0/32 to 32/32 (2 seeds); T1D 15,000/15,000 MAX_TOKENS postmortem; adopted as Cymek contract
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a (contract-level law)

beliefs.statement: Held-out LM loss improvement implies cognitive-ability improvement.
beliefs.prior_justification: Loss 2.1884 to 1.9710 with all probed cognition at 0/chance; replicated at TPU scale
beliefs.confidence: HIGH (for tested probe batteries; probe-floor caveat recorded)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a

beliefs.statement: Curriculum staging or aligned-teacher supervision accelerates OOD emergence.
beliefs.prior_justification: Curriculum delayed memorization with zero OOD in box (ARK-003); T1D arms B/C null at TPU scale; teacher diversity exhausted
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a (bounded)

beliefs.statement: Microtask/primitive mastery composes into full operations automatically.
beliefs.prior_justification: Teacher primitives reached 0.515 held-out while composed arithmetic stayed ~0
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a

beliefs.statement: A learned self-model can be trained on the current V4-substrate intervention basis.
beliefs.prior_justification: X1 PASS invalidated by always-negative baseline (0.9733 vs 0.9545 at prevalence 0.0267); IBQ bases unqualified; no checkpoint passes readiness v2
plausible_alternatives: self-modeling on a qualified, capable substrate (gated, not dead)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A readiness-v2-passing checkpoint + qualified IBQ basis beating constant baselines prospectively
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: readiness calibration on the next ARK-018-class parent

beliefs.statement: Calibrated candidate-scoring policies neutralize length/tokenization bias.
beliefs.prior_justification: Both calibrated policies select the fewest-token role 1.000 in 15/15 CUDA cells; production_scoring_mode still null
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A policy family passing the extended bias screen
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: CIT-C0 extended screen (no GPU needed for design)

beliefs.statement: Aggregate/canonical accuracy is sufficient evidence of a retained or robust capability.
beliefs.prior_justification: ARK-015 canonical 1.0 with robustness collapsed; BRAMASTRA 48.4% fully query-blind-explained
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: n/a

beliefs.statement: The tiered arithmetic evaluation surface (T1D-era) is a valid instrument for future lift-off claims.
beliefs.prior_justification: CITADEL-DATA-001/EVAL-001 mechanically verified: latest_position shortcut = 1.000 on every tier; 173 dev + 357 test docs verbatim in train; 13.5% train duplication; supply 0.004x of 500M demand
plausible_alternatives: repairable surface (requires new generator, dedup, shortcut-resistant answers)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A regenerated corpus passing contamination + shortcut attack screens
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: re-run tools/audit_tiered_corpus.py on a regenerated corpus
beliefs.value_of_resolving: HIGH (blocks any future arithmetic lift-off claim on this surface)

beliefs.statement: Affine QK normalization and residual-output 1/sqrt(2L) scaling are required scale-control mechanisms for the Core.
beliefs.prior_justification: Local mechanism priors: logit-RMS invariance to Q/K scale stress (<=1.0001 vs 256x unnormalized); residual growth ratio 0.12-0.23; frozen as D-024/D-025
beliefs.confidence: HIGH as mechanism prior; ZERO cognition evidence by design
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A no-QK arm matching learning outcomes at scale (the mandatory E2-style contrast)
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: no-QK ablation arm in the next multi-arm campaign

beliefs.statement: BF16 compute with FP32 master parameters/moments is the safe precision layout; native BF16 optimizer states are unsafe.
beliefs.prior_justification: Parity worst loss rel err 0.000118; BF16 moments overshoot clip ~0.3% (invariant violation); frozen D-026/D-028
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: A long-horizon parity failure

beliefs.statement: The 65/20/15 production mixture and the nine cognition-family fractions are good defaults for the next Core.
beliefs.prior_justification: Implementation decision only (hard-coded); E3 blocked; BRAMASTRA notes the missing zero-cognition control
plausible_alternatives: any other mixture; cognition fraction 5-30% unresolved
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: E3-class mixture screens (blocked on corpus + architecture winner)

beliefs.statement: The token-indexed WSD schedule (0 to 3e-4 over 50M, decay to 3e-5 at 5B) is validated for production runs.
beliefs.prior_justification: Unit-tested only; every executed run used bounded_warmup (citadel 500M audit)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: First production-schedule execution
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: execute canonical schedule once at PRE500M smoke scale

beliefs.statement: Scaling parameters/tokens will resolve the formation bottleneck (lift-off at scale).
beliefs.prior_justification: No experiment tests scale vs formation; T1-series 2.3x scale null is weak evidence against naive scaling; budget confound recorded
plausible_alternatives: formation bottleneck is representation-bound, not scale-bound (CYR-011 supports this alternative)
beliefs.what_would_falsify_it: CS-TRANSFER-001 + R1C outcomes showing representation, not scale, is binding
beliefs.cheapest_falsifier: the three planned Phase-2 experiments collectively
beliefs.value_of_resolving: VERY HIGH (this belief is the 500M rationale)
